Oncall Bot: [incident] High error rate detected on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 — paging oncall team
Oncall Bot: bridge -> https://incidents.redwood.example/bridges/abc123 · please ack if you can take lead
Samir R: ack, taking lead. Starting live triage. Can folks pull customer impact (top 5 customers, count of failed requests, any SLA exposures)?
Alex P: quick copy for Zendesk macro — short + empathetic. Use and adapt as needed.
Alex P: ```
Customer-facing macro (short):
We're aware of intermittent errors affecting text generation in EU-WEST-1. Our engineering team is actively investigating and we have a bridge open: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/abc123.
Please reply with any request IDs, timestamps, and a screenshot if available — that will help prioritization. We'll post an update within 30 minutes with next steps. — Redwood Support
```
Maria K: Status page draft to post now:
Investigating — Customers in eu-west-1 may see increased 5xx errors for text generation. Impact: elevated error rate for requests to /v1/generate; some customers may see degraded throughput. Engineers are investigating. Next update by +30m. Temporary mitigation: routing critical traffic to eu-west-2 where configured.
Jules (Support Lead): Agent triage checklist (copy into ticket private notes):
- confirm customer org id and affected endpoint(s)
- collect 1-3 failing request IDs + exact timestamps
- capture error response body and model/route used
- check if customer uses dedicated region routing or reserved capacity
- apply Zendesk macro and add private note with details
- escalate to SRE with request ids/traces if customer is high priority
Quick commands for SRE logs:
```
# fetch logs for a request id
curl -s 'https://logs.redwood.internal/query?req_id=REQ123' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN'
```
Chris L: Samir — I'll take the 1:30 handoff. Will need a 1-2 line TL;DR and where you left the bridge when you sign out.
Samir R: TL;DR right now: elevated 500s from euw1 on /v1/generate due to memory pressure in batcher processes. Rolling restart of affected batchers underway (3/12 restarted). Temp routing to eu-west-2 enabled for tiered customers. Top impacted orgs right now: AcmeCorp, Flowio, DataMart. Estimated mitigation window 25-35 mins. Posting status update now.
Zendesk Bot: Macro applied id: macro_5772 — queued replies to 12 tickets
Oncall Bot: Incident severity escalated to P1 at 1923456800
Alex P: Intercom quick snippet: "We're investigating an issue affecting text generation in EU. Engineers are working on a fix and we'll update within ~30 minutes. Please reply with any request IDs." Tag convo with incident, eu.
Maria K: Reminder — for enterprise accounts add CSM in reply and offer temporary failover to eu-west-2 if available.
Jules (Support Lead): Guidance for replies: avoid hard ETAs unless SRE confirms. Use 'initial estimate' language, refer to status page link, and add private notes with request ids.
Samir R: Handoff to Chris at 1923456845. Bridge remains open. Added bridge notes with top impacted orgs + request ids.
Chris L: Taking over. Support actions: triage any tickets from top-orgs, apply macro, mark as incident-acknowledged, escalate any VIPs to priority queue and ping me directly.
Zendesk Bot: 12 tickets updated, 3 escalated to priority queue
Oncall Bot: Incident resolved at 1923456899 — root cause identified as OOM in batcher process; nodes restarted and capacity scaled. Please follow postmortem runbook.
Samir R: Thanks team — postmortem owner set: Samir R. Draft started in incidents docs.
Jules (Support Lead): I will prepare customer-facing summary for CSMs and follow up with affected customers.
Chris L: We should also add a quick KB entry: how to collect request ids, where to find traces, and use the macro. I'll draft it after the postmortem.
